claim: CBG retains serpin protease inhibitory activity
finding: TBG and CBG retain the stressed native S conformation and the S-to-R transition, but 'there is no evidence of any retained protease inhibitory activity'
context: human plasma CBG and TBG, purified protein
conf: High; foundational, no quantitative Ki reported

finding: NE cleaves CBG RCL at Val344-Thr345 in seconds to minutes; CBG is consumed as a substrate, no inhibition reported
context: human blood-derived CBG + human neutrophil elastase and P. aeruginosa LasB, in vitro

claim: CBG performs the serpin S-to-R loop insertion
finding: Human CBG cleaved RCL inserts into beta-sheet A; cleaved segment is 5 residues longer than anticipated; rat CBG fails to undergo S-to-R at all
context: 2.5 A crystal structure, E. coli-produced human and rat CBG
conf: High; shows insertion competence but non-canonical cleavage site and species divergence

claim: CBG RCL hinge functions as an inhibitory hinge
finding: P15/P14/P12 substitutions block loop re-orientation; readout is steroid binding after cleavage, never protease inhibition
context: recombinant human CBG variants + neutrophil elastase
conf: High; the assayed output is hormone release, not inhibition

finding: Chymotrypsin and NE rapidly cleave the CBG RCL to completion, releasing cortisol; antibodies that block the RCL protect CBG from the proteases
conf: High; CBG is consumed, protease activity not reduced

claim: CBG RCL is a protease-inhibitor reactive site
finding: P. aeruginosa metalloprotease LasB cleaves the CBG RCL and destroys cortisol binding; serpins do not inhibit metalloproteases
context: human serum CBG + bacterial culture media
conf: Medium-high; shows RCL is a generic substrate loop

claim: CBG is a serine protease inhibitor
finding: Sequence similarity of CBG to alpha-1-antitrypsin and the serpin superfamily; no inhibition assay performed
conf: High that this is homology only; cited as TAS for GO:0004867

claim: CBG is mechanically capable of serpin inhibition
finding: Structural P1 = Thr349/Ser350 (mature), validated 6/6 vs PMID:19011238 numbering; NE cuts at P6-P5; hinge 6/7 (insertion-competent) but P14=Val vs Thr/Ser/Ala in 7/7 inhibitory serpins; UniProt annotates no 'Reactive bond' for P08185, P05543, P01019, P36955 but does for all 7 inhibitory serpins
conf: Medium-high; alignment-transferred anchors, PCI anchor slipped 3 aa vs UniProt

finding: All three independently state CBG is a non-inhibitory member of the serpin family whose function is glucocorticoid transport
conf: Medium; review-level, but authored by the structural and clinical primary groups
